help.title: Badge engine
help.intro: This page documents the engine. Secret badge rows stay in the database and are not part of this help text. A formula never reaches the public site until that badge is earned.
help.formulaBody: Where a badge filters clears or charts, the condition is a formula like Excel. Start with =. Compare fields with =, <>, >, >=, <, and <=. Combine them with AND, OR, NOT, and IF. ISBLANK checks a missing value, EXACT compares text with case, and HAS looks for a curation name. Example: =AND(speed>=2, OR(family="G", family="U")). An empty formula counts every row. The formula box only appears for badge types that filter rows.
help.filterBody: Only passes and charts that are not hidden and not deleted are visible. Wrong-judgement passes stay. A missing judgement bucket counts as 0. World-first checks also require speed exactly 1 and then follow the live world-first flag, which moves when an earlier 1.0x upload is accepted. The 5/40/5 placeholder sheet is skipped only by reducers that read judgements, accuracy, or score, and those reducers also ignore an all-zero sheet. Upload times 2023-01-01 07:27:27 and 2023-07-27 07:27:27 are unknown and are skipped by gap, sequence, nth-clearer, and earned-time ordering.
help.identityBody: level uses the chart id. chartSubgroup and vfxSubgroup collapse linked charts that share that subgroup. group collapses the whole link group. A clear only contributes its own chart's key count, difficulty, and curation. Clearing the unlimited sibling does not inherit the 10-key chart's key count. For a collapsed identity, the sibling clear is a reclear, not a second chart.
help.historyBody: difficultyAt walks level rerate history against the upload time. Before the first recorded change, the difficulty is that row's previous difficulty. With no history, the clear-time snapshot is used, then the chart's current difficulty. Snapshots are written when a pass is accepted or a world-first flag is refreshed. They store difficulty, base score, PP base score, curation type ids, and charter and VFXer ids. Older passes stay on current difficulty until something rewrites them.
help.curveBody: curve(credit, start, step) earns a tier when credit reaches start, then start plus step, and so on. curveDown(credit, start, step) is the descending form: start 4 and step 1 produces tiers at 4, then 3, then 2, then 1. result(tier, credit, from, to) sets the tier and the bar directly, which is how an all-or-nothing badge keeps a partial count from earning a tier. A plain number of 1 or more is itself the tier. Tier labels are { minTier, label } pairs. The label shown is the one with the greatest minTier that is still at or below the earned tier. common and legendary are examples, not a fixed list. An empty list shows no label. Shared creator credit is written in the expression, usually 0.5 when more than one person holds the role. Half a credit does not reach a start of 1.
help.grantBody: live recomputes and can be lost. persistTier keeps the highest tier reached. persistSnapshot freezes the chart set that satisfied a percent badge, so later charts do not raise the denominator. resetOnGrowth uses the live target, which is the pack default: a chart added to the pack removes completion until it is cleared. manualLock stays off until a reviewer approves a video. chase stores the current number, such as the lowest uncleared chart id. Saving a definition keeps persistTier and persistSnapshot results unless Replace earned tiers is on.
help.backfillBody: now evaluates every current public clear when the badge is published. forward ignores passes created before publication. queue only creates review rows and does not grant, except a manualLock badge which grants after approval. The job records how many passes it skipped for a placeholder sheet, an unknown upload time, or a missing difficulty history. Adding a badge later is the same job. Facts that were never stored, such as curation at the moment of an old clear, cannot be reconstructed.
help.reducersBody: threshold counts filtered clears or creator charts. aggregate is count, countDistinct, maxPerIdentity, maxPerSong, maxChartClears, maxSongsPerArtist, or ratingWeek. Filters include minSpeed, speedEquals, worldsFirst, worldsFirstPP, purePerfect, families, difficultyNames, difficultySet, key counts, minDurationMs, useDifficultyAt, requireNoPriorClear, curationTypes, role, and sole. coverage fills bins from a named set, every reference chart, one curation type, or a list of curation types. prefix stops at the first gap. percentOf needs fraction and minCharts. record uses metric accuracy, score, or speed, with optional world-first and highest score or speed. creditFrom otherClears uses the largest crowd on a chart the player still leads. pattern matches one pass: accuracyIncludes, ppMinusOne, minMisses, noMisses, symmetry, technicallyPure, noPerfects, asymmetry, gamma, bucketEquals, judgementPattern (7 integers: too-early, early, ePerfect, perfect, lPerfect, late, too-late), month, day, levelIds, families, minSpeed, minDurationMs, scoreEndsWith, or sharedAccuracy. sequence uses order, blocks, or rangeSize, with excludeDifficultyNames, perStep, and consecutive. gap uses minDays and stores the largest gap. nthClearer uses n. chase uses excludeDifficultyNames and shows the lowest uncleared id. best uses metric keyCount, perfectCount, difficultyNumber, misses, speed, or accuracy. manual wraps a pattern or sequence and waits for a review. pack takes packId. Folders and notes are ignored, a chart listed twice counts once, and the tier is earned only when every public chart in the pack is cleared. Official levels are whichever pack you select.
help.reviewBody: Approving a review requires a video URL and records the reviewer. Unearned secret badges are omitted from profiles. Other unearned badges show a name, icon, and progress bar, including the next number, but not the requirement text or the parameters. After a badge is earned, its tier label and proving passes are shown. accuracyFull and judgementsFull add server-rendered confirm text on that badge only. Public score cards keep the normal accuracy formatter.
help.valueBody: A badge expression returns the tier. clears are this player's public clears. levels are the public charts. mine are charts the creator is credited on, or charts this player has cleared. Filter with .filter(item => item.difficulty == "G10") and count with count(...) or .length. curve(count, start, step) and curveDown(count, start, step) turn that count into tiers. result(tier, credit, from, to) sets the tier and the bar directly. difficulty("G10") gives total, cleared, and ratio. sequence([ids]) and consecutive([ids], item => item.ppMinusOne) walk clears in upload order and return how many steps matched. blocks(10, "Impossible", "Censored") returns completed id blocks. prefix(set) counts a leading difficulty set. gap() is the longest gap in days. pack() is the charts in this badge's pack. complete(set) is 1 when every difficulty in the set is charted. nth(100), lead(level, "accuracy"), first(level), and shared() read other players. Placeholder 5/40/5 sheets keep their chart fields, but their accuracy and judgement fields are empty. This is a small expression language with JavaScript shape. It does not run arbitrary JavaScript.
